title: Classification and counting of Gorenstein simplices with $h^*$-polynomial $1+t^k+\cdots+t^{(v-1)k}$
summary: Hibi, Yoshida, and the author classified Gorenstein simplices which are not lattice pyramids and whose \(h^*\)-polynomials are of the form \(1+t^k+t^{2k}+\cdots+t^{(v-1)k}\) when \(v\) is a prime number or the product of two prime numbers. They also conjectured that, for general \(v\), the number of unimodular equivalence classes of such simplices depends only on the divisor lattice of \(v\).
